ABOUT US
ABOUT US
Pereira Construction of South Florida is a licensed General Contracting company located in South Florida. We handle projects of all shapes and sizes in both the Residential and Commercial sectors, operating primarily in Palm Beach and Broward counties. Our attention to detail and commitment to do the job right the first time truly sets us apart from others in the construction industry. We love helping our clients bring their visions to life. Our mission is simple:
Build lasting
Relationships
on a foundation of
Honesty
,
Reliability
, and
Quality Work
.
Founder and CEO, Robert Pereira, who has over 25 years of experience in the industry, has been licensed by the State of Florida as a Certified General Contractor since 2007. Throughout his time in the industry, Mr. Pereira has been involved in a variety of projects, ranging from Maintenance and General Repairs to Remodeling and New Construction.
​
Pereira Construction of South FL focuses its efforts into the following areas of expertise:
​
​Residential and Commercial
Remodeling
General Repairs
Pavers
​
Condo Boards / HOA / Multifamily
Capital Improvements
Interior and Exterior Renovations
​
We would appreciate the opportunity to earn your business. Contact us to go over your vision for your next project, and let us help you bring your vision to life. We'll be happy to hear from you.
CONTACT US
Serving all of South Florida.
Tel: (561) 248-9957
Hours of Operation:
Mon - Fri: 7am - 6pm
​​Saturday: 8am - 5pm
​Sunday: 8am - 5pm
​
We are available for after-hours emergencies.
